# U-Mamba (vendored)

`UMambaBot_3d.py` is copied unmodified from the official U-Mamba repository
(https://github.com/bowang-lab/U-Mamba, file `umamba/nnunetv2/nets/UMambaBot_3d.py`,
`main` branch, retrieved 2026-11-15) and is distributed under the Apache License 2.0
(see `LICENSE` in this folder).

Reference: Ma J, Li F, Wang B. U-Mamba: Enhancing Long-range Dependency for
Biomedical Image Segmentation. arXiv:2401.04722 (2024).

Only the thin wrapper in `strokebench/nets/reference.py` is ours.
